\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, itemsep=5cm]
  \item A tower is $100$ m tall. From a point on the ground the angle of

    to the base.
    \begin{center}
    \includegraphics[width=4cm]{tower_52deg_100m.png}

  \item From the same point, the angle of elevation to a balloon is
    $52^\circ$. The balloon is $100$ m up. Find the line-of-sight distance.
\end{enumerate}
